_comment: The issue #137 sweep corpus, pinned. run_sweep.py converts each package with rypip (which resolves the pinned version from PyPI into its cache), builds the generated crate, and records the rustc error histogram. Keep this list small and meaningful: each package adds a full convert+build to every sweep.

packages.name: urllib3
packages.note: The historical #137 corpus. Round 63: Option-receiver subscript stores unwrap + own (1033 -> 1029).

packages.name: certifi
packages.note: Close to a fully-clean package (was ~8 errors); a clean package is a far better regression canary than a 1600-error crate.

packages.name: idna
packages.note: Round 61: boxed-operand membership on literal lists (64).

packages.name: charset_normalizer
packages.note: Round 59: the Option-field store with a reused name wraps Some (312 -> 299).

packages.name: requests
packages.note: The dependent-package frontier (imports urllib3/charset_normalizer/idna/certifi; 112 errors at the round-54 baseline). Round 55: urllib.parse + class registry (69). Round 56: builtin-class values, tuple boxing, compat imports, del reads, range annotations (29). Round 57: module tuple-unpack promotion (25).
